newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 4.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Tuesday:
WASHINGTON - Lockheed Martin Corp said it will spin off 10 divisions with 5,000 employees to a newly created company.
TOKYO - America Online Inc is pushing for a piece of the action as millions of Japanese get online.

WASHINGTON - The Justice Department joined a lawsuit alleging one of the country's largest book wholesalers systematically overcharged libraries, universities and schools by as much as $200 million over a decade.
DAVOS, Switzerland - Microsoft Corp chairman Bill Gates is the most sought-after celebrity at the World Economic Forum.
